notes: Deploy ConditionalsV2 first, then ConditionalsZap on Robinhood Chain. ConditionalsV2 provides IMD conditional prediction markets with an LMSR maker and IdentityMD oracle settlement. Its explicit $owner can propose oracle configuration changes for future markets behind a three-day delay and set the fee recipient. ConditionalsZap has no owner and swaps ETH or USDG through the existing hookless Uniswap v4 pools before staking IMD for the caller in ConditionalsV2. Both constructors are nonpayable and make no external calls.
